messages:
Marie: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Marie: done: pushed ingress thinburst change + routing-policy fallback logic to staging. Verified with synthetic load (small dim test).
Marie: blocker: still seeing occasional 429s from eu-west on long sequences (~>1024 tokens) — looks like concurrency bucket blowup.
Marie: today: will canary the tweak to per-route concurrency and add a fallback metric. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/482 (canary tag) :eyes:

AJ: saw the staging run, throughput improved ~12%. nice. Any error traces?

Chris: quick note — I tested a rate config that seems stable under our thinburst pattern: 
```yaml
policy:
  id: thinburst-v2
  window_ms: 1000
  tokens: 60
  per_route: true
  fallback_policy: allow-with-backoff
```

Sophia: tagging @oncall-bot — we had a token validation spike at 03:20 UTC that coincided with the first flurry. probably unrelated but worth correlating (jwt kid mismatch).

oncall-bot: Incident alert created: INC-20260317-1222 — token-validation-fail spike. Pager duty: oncall-team.

AJ: Re: jwt mismatch — can someone grep for 401s with kid mismatch across gateway pods? I have a tiny grep: `kubectl logs -l app=gateway | grep "KID mismatch"`

Marie: running that now against prod-logs, will paste results to #incidents if I find any clear patterns.

Chris: if jwt rotation is the cause we should fallback to the older key for validation for ~5m to prevent client-side 401 cascades. also add a metric `policy_fallback_count` so Optimize can hook on it.

Sophia: assigned to me to add `policy_fallback_count` and a small dashboard tile (SLO: keep fallback <0.5% of requests). ETA: EOD.

Marie: plan: canary at 11:30 PT, watch 429s + fallback metric for 30m, revert on spike. Blocking only if fallback >1% or 429s increase. :thumbsup:

AJ: cool — I'll be standing by for rollback. ping me with `@AJ` in thread if you need immediate rollback.

Sophia: will also roll the auth rotation fix to staging and validate KID propagation across regions.

Marie: thanks team — that's it from me for today.

AJ: thanks!

Chris: lgtm

oncall-bot: Note: alert INC-20260317-1222 acknowledged by Sophia at 2026-03-17T11:35:00Z

Marie: end of thread.
